text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... I suppose that at 
least counts as getting a result.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Still, I am not one to settle for this. 
King Halo is a top-class Umamusume, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You understand as well, don't you?
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's bring home results fit 
for someone first-rate.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That's right, I am King Halo.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nothing less than first-rate, nothing less 
than 1st place suits her— the greatest 
Umamusume of this century!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The only place befitting a King is the 
throne itself. Come, next time we shall 
seize the top!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I see you understand as 
well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So, how about staying up tonight to come 
up with training and a strategy worthy of 
someone first-class?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm expecting great things from 
you... First-rate work worthy of managing 
a first-rate Umamusume, that is.
